$comment: Operations without a UI caller (scripts/check-api-coverage.mjs). apiOnly: deliberate, with the reason. planned: the screen is scheduled (increment 7 milestone); this list must end empty.

apiOnly.trade_approve: Approval goes through the TRADE_APPROVAL task in the inbox (workflow_approve), which records the decision; kept for API clients
apiOnly.trade_reject: Rejection goes through the TRADE_APPROVAL task in the inbox (workflow_reject); kept for API clients
apiOnly.allocation_approve: Plan approval goes through the ALLOCATION_APPROVAL task in the inbox (workflow_approve); kept for API clients
apiOnly.allocation_reject: Plan rejection goes through the ALLOCATION_APPROVAL task in the inbox (workflow_reject); kept for API clients
apiOnly.trade_trades: Unpaged list for integrations; the blotter uses the keyset-paged trade_search
apiOnly.registry_open: Open-instruction list for integrations; the registry screen uses the paged instruction search
apiOnly.registry_surrender: EU ETS surrenders are requested from the installation (etsCompliance_requestSurrender), which attributes them; the raw instruction would skip attribution
apiOnly.inventory_importStatement: Structured holdings import for registry API adapters; people upload statement files through the registry format profiles (registry statements CSV)
apiOnly.inventory_expire: Trigger for the nightly lot expiry job, for operations scripts
apiOnly.marketData_rate: FX conversion service for other systems; the market data screen shows the stored rates
apiOnly.audit_event: Single audit event by id for integrations; the audit trail shows events in full in its list
apiOnly.audit_verify: Seal chain check of the audit trail for auditors' tools and operations scripts; the nightly chain verification reports it as the etrm.integrity.chain.ok metric
apiOnly.changeRequest_changeRequest: Single change request by id; the change request list and the inbox task show it in full
apiOnly.referenceData_book: Single book by id; books are shown from the legal entity's book list
apiOnly.product_bucket: Single product bucket by code; the products screen shows buckets from its list
apiOnly.taxonomy_get: Single taxonomy node; the taxonomy editor loads the whole tree
apiOnly.taxonomy_subtree: Taxonomy subtree for integrations; the taxonomy editor loads the whole tree
apiOnly.payment_payment: Single payment by id; the payments tab shows payments in full in its list
apiOnly.eventPublication_parked: Operations endpoint for administrators, used from the event-publications runbook
apiOnly.eventPublication_resubmit: Operations endpoint for administrators, used from the event-publications runbook
